# tidy-idy Intent (Locked North Star)

Objective: Author the `tidy-idy` skill in the Skill Foundry as a ruthless, adversarial repository hygiene enforcer. Leveraging the `gandalf` deep-think backbone, it will proactively scan active Foundry projects (running on a regular schedule, e.g., weekly) to tidy up the workspace. It will strictly preserve core working code but relentlessly target obsolete, unused code, and dead materials for deletion or archival. It must challenge the host skill in an adversarial, multi-round debate to justify the retention of assets based on their direct utility to the skill's North Star. Finally, it will compress and maintain a tight `agent.md` file, shifting historical context into `agent_hist.md` while retaining a brief executive summary. It will also enforce strict Git hygiene, ensuring all repos are merged, pushed, and completely current.
